# Vendor Documentation

This folder contains vendor-supplied ISO 20022 documentation and templates for
this implementation.

**This is not the official ISO 20022 site.** The sole source for the most
up-to-date ISO 20022 message standards and repository is
[iso20022.org](https://www.iso20022.org/).

Externally licensed source standards may only be added here when their
license explicitly permits redistribution. Before adding any such file,
confirm the license and record the source/terms in the table below.

## Files

| File | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [.gitkeep](.gitkeep) | Placeholder file so the folder remains tracked when content changes. |
| [ISO20022_MDRPart2_PaymentsClearingAndSettlement_2024_2025_v1.pdf](ISO20022_MDRPart2_PaymentsClearingAndSettlement_2024_2025_v1.pdf) | ISO 20022 Message Definition Report Part 2 (Payments Clearing and Settlement, Maintenance 2024-2025), sourced from the ISO 20022 Financial Repository. Redistributed under the [ISO 20022 Intellectual Property Rights Policy](https://www.iso20022.org/intellectual-property-rights) and [Terms of Use](https://www.iso20022.org/terms-use), which grant a non-exclusive, royalty-free license to use and reproduce published Repository material. |

## Usage

- Add new vendor documents with clear, versioned filenames when possible.
- Keep source files unchanged and add derived notes under [docs/internal/](../internal/).
- Remove obsolete vendor files when they are superseded.
